title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.57 (versions follow prime numbers; 157 after 151): her voice, and her whole answer. Each time Luma answers she now chooses between two ways with her usual wishes, (S + 1/2) / (N + 1) for each way, paid when she is answered back: to quote (her line as it is, saying the book it comes from) or to say it her way (joining lines as in 1.49 and keeping only the sentences that touch what was said to her, signed by her). Her answer is shown whole, in lines cut by the real width of each letter, eight at a time; Page Up and Page Down move along it, and a dot at the side shows there is more. Tested: asked 'abraham padre del atomo radiactivo' she answered in her own words 'Abraham fue padre de la desintegracion beta en un atomo radiactivo.'; asked about light and energy she chose to quote, naming the book. Stated limits: her own words are still made of what she read; lines are cut by letter, not by word; a long sentence that touches the message stays whole; quotes are cut at 1000 bytes. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.57: Luma cita cuando quiere y, si no, contesta a su manera; su respuesta se ve entera. Prototipo de investigación.
